name: seis-ai-agent
description: Versioned unified SEIS-AI Agent that installs as one default public SEIS surface and orchestrates every embedded governance, cloud, code, design, data, security, research, automation, and product lane.

interface.shortDescription: The one public SEIS plugin that coordinates every embedded module.
interface.longDescription: SEIS-Agent 0.3.0 is the only public SEIS install surface. It embeds SEIS, SEIS-Cloud, SEIS-Code, SEIS-Design, SEIS-Data, SEIS Security, SEIS Research, SEIS Automation, and SEIS Product as internal source modules while preserving older personal installations without publishing duplicate public plugin cards.
capabilities: SEIS Security threat, secret, and release-risk review
SEIS Research evidence and source evaluation
SEIS Automation repeatable workflow and runbook design
SEIS Product roadmap, scope, and acceptance criteria
defaultPrompt: Use SEIS-AI Agent to route this work across cloud, code, design, and data.
Use SEIS-AI Agent to route security, research, automation, and product work to the right embedded lane.
Plan the next SEIS-AI Agent milestone without publishing prematurely.
Prepare a cross-platform terminal install path for this SEIS capability.
Shape the cinematic website and product experience roadmap for SEIS-AI Agent.
